definitions.full: H7706. Shadday שַׁדַּי 48 noun masculine, of deity (etymology dubious (I) Aq Symm Theod ἱκανός ; Rabb שֶֿׁ + דַּי (self-) sufficient , no moderns. (2) = almighty , √ שׁדד + י = Thes De Di Sta, or √ שׁדה = שׁדד , intensive noun Ew § 155 c , but שׁדד (q. v.) is deal violently not simply mightily ; compare ᵐ5 παντοκράτωρ 14(15) t. (but in Pentateuch ׳אלשׁ is ό Θεόχ μου, σου , etc.), ᵑ9 mostly omnipotens . (3) < conjecture for original שֵׁדַי (see שֵׁד ) my sovereign lord , || בעלי אֲדֹנָי, Nö SBA 1880, 775; ZMG xlii (1888), 481 ; Hoffm Ph. Inscr. 53 ; used of foreign deities ( Deut 32:17 ), and so discredited (compare בַּעַל ). — > other conjectures, e.g. RS OTJC, 424 √ שׁדה pour forth (God as rain-giver); Dl Pr 96 followed by Assyrian šadû, high, ilu šâdû a, Che Comm. Isaiah 2:148 , or šadû, mountain , also in proper name; see further Dr Gen 404 ff. ); — 1 שַׁדַּי Num 24:4 , 16 (J E, poem), and so as archaism Ruth 1:20-21 , Psa 68:15 ; 91:1 ; Joel 1:15 = Isa 13:6 ; Ezek 1:24 (strike out Co); especially Job 5:17 + 30:t. Job (+ 19:29 Ew Di, reading ׳שׁ for שׁדין ). 2 שַׁדַּי אֵל Gen 49:25 (poem; so read for שׁ ׳אֵת , see ᵑ6 ᵐ5 ⅏ Saad, Hebrew Manuscripts), and so, as archaism, divine name of patriarchs in P, 17:1 ; 28:3 ; 35:11 ; 48:3 ; Exod 6:3 ; Gen 43:14 (R P ); so Ezek 10:5 (strike out Co; but ᵐ5 Σαδδαι ). שַׁדּ֯יּן Job 19:29 see דין above. שׁדם √of following; meaning unknown).
